programme.title: Loši momci zauvek
programme.desc: Sedamnaest godina nakon poslednjeg zajedničkog slučaja, Majk i Markus ponovo udružuju snage! Ovog puta moraju da uhvate udovicu mafijaša Benita, koja uz pomoć sina Armanda planira pravi osvetnički pohod.

programme.title: Grand Budapest hotel
programme.desc: Radnja prati gospodina Gistava, šarmantnog i posvećenog konsijerža luksuznog hotela, koji biva lažno optužen za ubistvo bogate grofice nakon što mu ona u testamentu ostavi neprocenjivu sliku. U poteri koja sledi, Gistavu pomaže njegov odani potrčko, mladi Zero.

programme.title: Astralna podmuklost Poglavlje 2
programme.desc: Astralna podmuklost: Poglavlje 2 donosi priču o porodici Lambert koja na sve načine pokušava da otkrije razlog zbog kojeg su povezani sa duhovima.

programme.title: Poslednji vitezovi
programme.desc: Pali ratnik se bori protiv korumpiranog i sadističkog vladara kako bi osvetio svog osramoćenog gospodara. Kada korumpirani sveštenik Geza Mot zatraži veće namete od lorda Bartoka, lord odlazi u svoj zamak sa zapovednikom Rajdenom i njegovim vitezovima. Izaziva Gezu Mota i pokušava da ga ubije, ali car naređuje da Rajden lordu odrubi glavu. Oduzima lordu zamak i sve porodične posede. Geza Mot traži od zapovednika da prati Rajdena i na ulazu u svoj zamak gradi gvozdenu kapiju očekujući osvetu. Godinu dana kasnije, lordovi vitezovi traže osvetu zbog nepoštovanja svog gospodara… Klajv Oven, glumac koji je svojevremeno nominovan za nagradu Oskar, fascinantan je u ulozi palog ratnika koji se bori protiv korumpiranog i sadističkog vladara kako bi osvetio svog osramoćenog gospodara – 'oskarovca' Morgana Frimana – u ovoj epskoj mačevalačkoj avanturi koja govori o lojalnosti, časti i osveti.

programme.title: Spremna ili ne
programme.desc: Film predstavlja jedinstven spoj crnog humora, horora i napete akcije. Radnja prati mladu nevestu Grejs koja tokom svadbene noći na imanju bogate porodice svog muža biva primorana da učestvuje u smrtonosnoj igri žmuraka, pretvarajući se iz uplašene žrtve u borca za opstanak.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Posle očeve smrti, tri sestre – Eleni, Asimina i Droso pokušavaju da opstanu i prežive u malom i izrazito konzervativnom mestu u Grčkoj. Sergios je najmoćniji zemljoposednik i uticajan meštanin koji po svaku cenu želi da oženi sina najstarijom sestrom Eleni kako bi se dokopao njihovog imanja. Ona nevoljno pristaje na ponudu jer zna da je to jedini način da se reše dugova u koje su upale posle smrti oba roditelja. Sestre nisu ni slutile kakva će ih sudbina zadesiti posle takve odluke. U noći venčanja, Eleni i Asimina uprljaće ruke mladoženjinom krvlju sprečavajući ga u pokušaju silovanja njihove najmlađe sestre Droso. Meštani će biti šokirani kada telo mladog, bahatog naslednika bude otkriveno. Tri sestre čine sve kako se istina ne bi otkrila dok svemoćna porodica ne preza ni od čega kako bi pronašla pravog krivca. U tom pokušaju, najmračnije tajne iz prošlosti izlaze polako na svetlost dana i okreću život svima naopačke.

programme.title: Marisol
programme.desc: Ožiljak na licu, buket cveća u rukama i život koji joj nije bio nimalo naklonjen – tako upoznajemo Marisol, junakinju jedne od najvoljenijih meksičkih telenovela svih vremena. Serija koja je devedesetih osvajala milione gledalaca širom sveta od 31. avgusta stiže na Una televiziju, radnim danima u 14.40 časova. U nezaboravnoj ulozi je Érika Buenfil, koja je Marisol pretvorila u junakinju za koju se navija od prvog do poslednjeg kadra. Skromna devojka prodaje cveće na ulici kako bi prehranila bolesnu majku, ne sluteći da je zapravo naslednica bogate i ugledne porodice. Kada se u njen život umeša ljubav, počinje vrtlog tajni, izdaja i velikih preokreta. Sa Hose Andresom prolazi kroz iskušenja koja će testirati njihovu ljubav do krajnjih granica – uključujući i bolnu potragu za sinom koji im je oduzet. Kada je 1996. godine emitovana u Meksiku i širom Latinske Amerike, Marisol je postala pravi televizijski fenomen, a Érika Buenfil zbog ogromne popularnosti serije krenula je i na promotivnu turneju po Latinskoj Americi i Evropi. I danas ova priča ima posebnu publiku – jer neke telenovele jednostavno ne zastarevaju. A znate li ko je Marisolin partner? Eduardo Santamarina – isti onaj fatalni zavodnik kojeg pamtimo kao Alehandra iz čuvene serije Rubí.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Ulica lipa
programme.desc: U srcu jedne obične ulice, među kućama, dvorištima i starim lipama, žive ljudi koje ćete odmah zavoleti – njihove male radosti, nesporazumi, komične situacije i iskrene emocije osvojiće vas već od prve epizode. Ova domaća serija donosi niz životnih situacija koje dokazuju da humor, ljubav i solidarnost još uvek žive u našem svakodnevnom okruženju. Ono što Ulicu lipa čini još posebnijom jeste sjajna glumačka postava koju čine neka od najvoljenijih imena domaće kinematografije: Radmila Živković, Josif Tatić, Ana Franić, Nada Šargin, Dragan Mićanović, Milorad Mandić Manda, Aleksandra Janković, Nataša Ninković, Svetlana Bojković, i mnogi drugi. Ova serija donosi onu posebnu, prepoznatljivu iskrenost domaćih priča – humor iz svakodnevnice, duhovite dijaloge, ali i dirljive momente koji nas podsećaju na to koliko su blizina, razumevanje i komšijski duh važni u današnjem vremenu.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 13.30 časova, uz Marijanu Tabaković, Bojanu Bojović i Ivana Vukajlovića, donosi teme koje su deo svakodnevice gledalaca, korisne informacije, stručne savete i razgovore sa zanimljivim sagovornicima. Voditelji se smenjuju u parovima i kroz dinamičan i neposredan razgovor otvaraju različite životne i društvene teme – od zdravlja, porodice i međuljudskih odnosa do svakodnevnih dilema, praktičnih saveta i priča koje zaslužuju pažnju. Uz goste u studiju i priče sa terena, Popodne prati ono što zanima i dotiče gledaoce, u opuštenoj atmosferi i uz mnogo prostora za iskrene razgovore, korisne odgovore i dobru energiju.

Kada je 1996. godine emitovana u Meksiku i širom Latinske Amerike, Marisol je postala pravi televizijski fenomen, a Érika Buenfil zbog ogromne popularnosti serije krenula je i na promotivnu turneju po Latinskoj Americi i Evropi. I danas ova priča ima posebnu publiku – jer neke telenovele jednostavno ne zastarevaju. A znate li ko je Marisolin partner? Eduardo Santamarina – isti onaj fatalni zavodnik kojeg pamtimo kao Alehandra iz čuvene serije Rubí.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 13.30 časova, uz Marijanu Tabaković, Bojanu Bojović i Ivana Vukajlovića, donosi teme koje su deo svakodnevice gledalaca, korisne informacije, stručne savete i razgovore sa zanimljivim sagovornicima. Voditelji se smenjuju u parovima i kroz dinamičan i neposredan razgovor otvaraju različite životne i društvene teme – od zdravlja, porodice i međuljudskih odnosa do svakodnevnih dilema, praktičnih saveta i priča koje zaslužuju pažnju. Uz goste u studiju i priče sa terena, Popodne prati ono što zanima i dotiče gledaoce, u opuštenoj atmosferi i uz mnogo prostora za iskrene razgovore, korisne odgovore i dobru energiju.

programme.title: Una vesti
programme.desc: Una vesti donose najtačnije informacije o najvažnijim domaćim i svetskim događajima – svakog dana u 13 i 15 časova. Nepristrasno, prodorno i brzo novinarstvo, uz lokalni pristup, čini da gledaoci Una televizije budu pravovremeno i pouzdano informisani. Savremene vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i upotreba virtuelne stvarnosti, pružaju jedinstven i dinamičan doživljaj praćenja informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 16.30 časova, uz Anu Šupić i Boška Jakovljevića, donosi pregled aktuelnih tema iz zemlje i sveta, razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima i priče reportera sa terena. Poseban prostor posvećen je društvu i kulturi – temama koje pokreću javnost, zanimljivim ljudima i događajima koji obeležavaju svakodnevicu, uz razgovore koji nude različite poglede i odgovore na aktuelna pitanja. Uz poznate ličnosti, priče iz sveta kulture i zabave i muziku benda u studiju, Ana i Boško završnicu dana provode sa gledaocima u prepoznatljivoj atmosferi Popodneva – spontano, neposredno i uz dobru energiju.

programme.title: Očima deteta
programme.desc: Emisija Očima deteta donosi zabavne igre, edukativne segmente i dečje perspektive na bitne i svakodnevne teme. Naše male zvezde istražuju svet kroz igru postavljajući pitanja na važne (i manje važne) životne dileme, dok su poznate ličnosti i stručnjaci iz različitih oblasti specijalni gosti u studiju Una televizije i pokušavaju i sami da se snađu dečjoj stolici.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Tereza
programme.desc: Tereza je lepa i inteligentna devojka koja ne pristaje na život u siromaštvu. Iako je okružena ljubavlju porodice i Marijana, mladića koji je iskreno voli, ona sanja o bogatstvu, luksuzu i društvenom ugledu. Odlučna da sakrije svoje skromno poreklo, koristi šarm i lepotu kako bi postala deo sveta kojem oduvek želi da pripada. Posle ljubavnog razočaranja i poniženja, njena želja za uspehom postaje još snažnija. U bogatom i uglednom profesoru Arturu vidi priliku da zauvek promeni svoj život, ali osećanja prema Marijanu ne prestaju da je prate. Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Dobro veče sa Andrijom
programme.desc: Počinje Dobro veče as Andrijom, šou u kojem će uživati ceo region! Ogromna doza smeha i fantastični gosti uz jedinstvenog domaćina, pretvoriće petak veče na UNA TV u magiju koja će svima popraviti raspoloženje. Nju ne treba previše predstavjati, njoj to ne treba, ali ona ima malo čudno prezime pa čovek može malo da se zbuni. I ja sam se tako u mladosti zbunjivao. BIli su tako neki veliki ljudi, velike zvezde, koji su imali više reči u prezimenu pa sam mislio da ima više ljudi u jednoj osobi Žan Klod van Dam, Mira Adanja Polak, Žan Pjer Papen, Mbape me je isto zbunjivao ali ona je jedna, jedinstvena, i to ne bilo koja...već Andrijina Anđelka, najavio je na svoj način Andrija svoju prvu gošću, popularnu glumicu, Anđelku Stević Žugić. Pogledajte kako će se ovaj sjajan glumački tandem snaći u improvizacijama, skečevima, međusobnim prozivkama i izazovima u kojima se neće štedeti. Videćemo zašto je Andrija smestio Anđelku u zatvor i premijerno čuti njihovu omiljnu pesmu koju će Anđelka otpevati uživo! Otkriće nam zbog čega ova pesma ima posebno značenje za njih dvoje, zašto Andrija nosi gaće na glavi zbog Anđe, s kojim specijalnim gostom će je iznenaditi u studiju ali čućemo i jedan potpuno otvoren razgovor o ozbiljnm životnim izazovima pred kojima su našli i kako su uspeli da ih prevaziđu.

programme.title: Loši momci
programme.desc: Dva detektiva štite svedoka ubistva dok istražuju slučaj povezan sa drogom u vrednosti od 100 miliona dolara.

programme.title: Terminator 3: Pobuna mašina
programme.desc: U trećem nastavku ovog filma, T-800 je ponovo zaštitnik Džona Konora i njegove buduće supruge. Ovog puta on će morati da ih štiti od ženskog terminatora T-X, još naprednijeg prototipa poslatog da ih ubije.

programme.title: Dobrodošli u džunglu
programme.desc: Ova akcijska komedija donosi priču o bivšem ugostitelju Beku koji mora otići u Brazil i pronaći Trejvisa, mafijaševa neodgovornog sina kako bi prikupio dugove.

programme.title: Gospodar i komandant: Daleka strana sveta
programme.desc: Za vreme Napoleonovih ratova, drski britanski kapetan komanduje svojim brodom i posadom do njihovih krajnjih granica izdržljivosti, sve u potrazi za strašnim francuskim, ratnim brodom, ploveći oko obala Južne Amerike.

programme.title: To je život
programme.desc: Od 14. marta, svakog četvrtka, premijerno na UNA televiziji gledaćete emisiju To je život - jedinstveni autorski projekat više puta nagrađivane talentovane novinarke Jasne Đurović: Emisija To je život je ostvarenje mog sna, onog najvećeg koji sam imala još onog dana kad sam odlučila da studiram novinarstvo. Znala sam da nikada ne želim da se bavim ovim poslom na današnji, uobičajen, način - da samo nešto zabeležim i prenesem. Meni je novinarstvo prilika da utičem, promenim i na prvom mestu pomognem i čoveku i društvu u celini. Ono što će gledaoci moći da vide u mojim emisijima u kojima se pojavljujem i kao voditelj i kao novinar - zaista će biti najveće životne priče. One koje i bukvalno liče na filmski scenario, a u stavri ne mogu biti istinitije. To je ono što samo život može da priredi i odredi i što se samo životom objašnjava. Zato se emisija i zove kako se zove i beleži zaista one nejneverovatnije stvari. Neverovatna Jasna ne krije i da veliku zahvalnost duguje svojoj medijskoj kući: Dugujem ogromnu, ali ogromnu zahvalnost, UNA televiziji koja mi je ukazala tu čast i privilegiju da tačno na osamnaestogodišnjicu televizijske karijere dobijem autorsku emisiju i da to bude baš ono što je na neki način i obeležilo moj dosadašnji rad. Ono što zaista mislim da najbolje umem i što osećam - ne samo kao posao, već i kao suštinu svog bića.

programme.title: Derviš i smrt
programme.desc: Ahmet Nurudin, derviš i starešina islamskog manastira u Sarajevu je personifikacija morala i dogmatskog verovanja, svega na čemu počiva muslimanska vera. Kroz njegov život, atmosferu grada i odnosa sa sudijom, otkriva se slika Osmanskog carstva na početku devetnaestog veka.

programme.title: Jedne letnje noći
programme.desc: Lola i Krinka su dve sestre, iako veoma različite, obe su veoma lepe i zanimljive. One žive sa roditeljima koji čuvaju veliku tajnu koja se tiče Krinkinog porekla. Sestre zajedno sa majkom kreću na putovanje, posle kog više ništa neće biti isto.

programme.title: Jedne letnje noći
programme.desc: Lola i Krinka su dve sestre, iako veoma različite, obe su veoma lepe i zanimljive. One žive sa roditeljima koji čuvaju veliku tajnu koja se tiče Krinkinog porekla. Sestre zajedno sa majkom kreću na putovanje, posle kog više ništa neće biti isto.

programme.title: Doktor Mladen
programme.desc: Doktor Mladen Stojanović, lekar iz Prijedora i jedan od vođa ustanka na Kozari, okupio je oko sebe veliki broj seljaka iz okolnih mesta. Nakon pobede nad neprijateljskim snagama na Mrakovici 1941. godine, stekao je status narodnog heroja i postao simbol otpora među lokalnim stanovništvom.

programme.title: SportUna
programme.desc: Sportuna donosi savremen i dinamičan format koji spaja stručnu analizu, ekskluzivna gostovanja i zabavan ugao posmatranja sporta. U centru pažnje su najvažnija dešavanja iz Evrolige, sa posebnim fokusom na učinak KK Crvena zvezda i KK Partizan, ali i velika međunarodna sportska takmičenja, uključujući i predstojeće Svetsko prvenstvo u fudbalu. Voditeljski tandem Milan Bošković i Milutin Aleksić vode gledaoce kroz pregled najvažnijih sportskih aktuelnosti tokom nedelje – od analize ključnih utakmica i razgovora sa relevantnim imenima iz sveta sporta, do uključenja igrača koji nastupaju u inostranstvu. Poseban kvalitet emisije ogleda se u pažljivo građenom balansu između ozbiljne, argumentovane analize i opuštenijeg tona koji sport približava širokoj publici. Pored stručnih komentara voditelja, u studiju gostuju i javne ličnosti koje sport doživljavaju pre svega kao strast i navijačko iskustvo, donoseći lični pogled, emociju i autentičnost koja emisiju čini bliskom i prepoznatljivom širokom krugu gledalaca.

programme.title: Mućke
programme.desc: Legendarnu britansku seriju Mućke (eng. Only Fools and Horses) gledaoci Una televizije gledaju ponovo s velikom pažnjom i radošću jer dogodovštine porodice Troter su jednostavno vanvremenske. Ovo je priča o nesvakidašnjim avanturama braće Delboja i Rodnija, koje su tumačili sjajni glumci Ser Dejvid Džejson (David Jason) i Nikolas Lindherst (Nicholas Lyndhurst). Serija je prvi put emitovana 1981. godine na BBC-ju i trajala je sve do 2003. godine, obuhvatajući sedam sezona i 64 epizode, uključujući božićne specijale. U svojoj autobiografiji My Life, Dejvid Džejson je podelio anegdotu o lažnoj svađi sa Lindherstom tokom snimanja. Zbog dosade na setu, odlučili su da insceniraju žestoku raspravu, bacajući predmete i vičući jedan na drugog, što je prestravilo članove ekipe koji su pokušali da ih smire. Jednog dana Nik i ja smo bili u našoj maloj prikolici na setu. Bilo nam je dosadno, jer se ništa nije dešavalo, pa smo se dogovorili: 'Zašto ne bismo inscenirali veliku svađu i ti izjuriš, kažeš da sve napuštaš, a ja mogu da vičem za tobom da ne treba nikad više da se vratiš', izjavio je Džejson. Kasnije su priznali da je sve bila šala, ali je ova priča doprinela glasinama o njihovom navodnom sukobu. Uprkos glasinama o navodnoj svađi, Džejson i Nikolas su uvek isticali međusobno poštovanje i prijateljstvo. Džejson je izjavio: Niste mogli imati boljeg partnera od Nika. Voleli smo se i poštovali toliko mnogo; bili smo istinski dobri prijatelji. Nakon završetka serije, Lindherst je nastavio da glumi u raznim

programme.title: Jedno pitanje
programme.desc: Ovaj jedinstveni kviz nije samo test znanja već nesvakidašnja kombinacija znanja, igre i super zabave. Za osvajanje novčane nagrade od čak 500.000,00 dinara takmičarima su potrebni intuicija, malo sreće i nezaobilazna podrška šarmantne voditeljke Marije Kilibarde. Pravila su jednostavna: svaki takmičarski par dobija jedno pitanje i 16 ponuđenih odgovora. Kroz sistem eliminacije, pokušavaju da pronađu jedini tačan odgovor, i uz pažljivo razmišljanje i mrvu odvažnosti, nagrada može biti njihova.

Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Loši momci 2
programme.desc: Nakon što su ostavili kriminalnu prošlost iza sebe i pokušavaju da pronađu svoje mesto u svetu dobrih momaka, Vuk i njegova ekipa suočavaju se sa najvećim izazovom do sada – da zadobiju poverenje i prihvatanje onih kojima su nekada ulivali strah. Međutim, miran život neće dugo potrajati. Misteriozna ženska kriminalna grupa izvlači ih iz penzije i primorava da se upuste u još jednu pljačku.

programme.title: Terminator: Spasenje
programme.desc: Budućnost u koju je Konor verovao delimično je izmenjena pojavom Markusa Vrajta, stranca čije je poslednje sećanje njegova smrtna kazna. Konor mora da odluči da li je Markus poslat iz budućnosti ili spašen iz prošlosti. Dok se Skajnet priprema za konačni udar, Konor i Markus kreću u odiseju koja ih odvodi u središte operacija Skajneta, gde otkrivaju užasnu tajnu mogućeg uništenja ljudske vrste.

programme.title: Pljačka za vreme uragana
programme.desc: Dok se približava smrtonosni uragan, grupa kriminalaca ulazi u američku kovnicu novca kako bi ukrali ogromnu količinu novca. Stvari kreću po zlu kada agentkinja zadužena za krizne situacije i jedan meteorolog odluče da osujete njihov plan.

programme.title: Teška vremena u El Rojalu
programme.desc: El Rojal je hotel koji je davno bio popularan u krugovima ljudi koji se kockaju. U hotel jedne večeri stiže sedmoro stranaca koji žele da šokantne tajne koje čuvaju zauvek ostanu skrivene.

programme.title: Most
programme.desc: Da bi zaustavili nemačku ofanzivu, partizani šalju elitni tim stručnjaka za eksplozive da raznesu strateški važan most. Osim što je brižljivo čuvan, most je takoreći neuništiv i jedini čovek koji zna njegove slabe kontrukcione tačke je arhitekta koji ga je i sagradio. On, međutim, okleva da sarađuje jer mu je žao da vidi svoje remek delo uništeno.

programme.title: Krugovi
programme.desc: Savremena priča o jednom herojskom delu, i njegovim pozitivnim posledicama. Tri paralelne priče odvijaju se u Beogradu, Nemačkoj i Trebinju, prateći likove koji su, kao svedoci događaja iz prošlosti, motivisani da donose odluke koje će im promeniti živote. Nebojša, svedok događaja u kom je stradao njegov najbolji prijatelj, prevazilazi grižu savesti suočavajući se sa ubicom svog prijatelja; Haris, koji život duguje junaku koji se žrtvovao za njega, dug vraća rizikujući sve i pomažući ugroženoj ženi; a sin jednog od ubica u susretu sa ocem stradalog heroja otvara put za prevazilaženje tragične prošlosti.

programme.title: Marija Antoaneta
programme.desc: Mlada autrijska princeza se sa samo 14 godina udaje za francuskog princa, nazaiteresovanog Luja XVI. Udajom, njena borba počinje. Kako je bila izolovana i prezrena na dvoru, utehu je pronalazila u kupovini skupocenih haljina, slatkišima i kockanju. I dvoru i puku prkosila je svojim ekcentičnim životom, a zapravo je samo bila duboko nesrećna.

programme.title: Kakodalogija
programme.desc: Emisija Kakodalogija, autora i voditelja Ivana Stankovića, otkriva šta se zaista krije iza velikih životnih i profesionalnih ostvarenja poznatih ličnosti i traži odgovor na pitanje – kako se postaje uspešan? Kroz jednosatne razgovore jedan na jedan sa ljudima koji su napravili značajne karijere i ostavili trag u svetu biznisa, kulture, sporta i javnog života, Ivan Stanković istražuje ono što često ostaje izvan poznatih biografija – neuspehe, pogrešne odluke, trenutke sumnje, strahove, prekretnice i izazove koji su oblikovali put njegovih sagovornika. Polazeći od jednostavnog pitanja kako da?, Kakodalogija istražuje kako prepoznati pravu priliku, doneti odluku kada nema dovoljno informacija, nastaviti nakon promašaja ili velikog pada i pronaći snagu za novi početak. Kroz konkretna iskustva gostiju, emisija otkriva koliko su na putu do cilja važni talenat i sreća, a koliko upornost, disciplina, hrabrost i spremnost na promene. Kakodalogija tako prevazilazi okvir klasičnog biografskog razgovora i postaje svojevrsni masterclass o životu, karijeri, ranjivosti i donošenju odluka, nudeći gledaocima ne samo inspiraciju, već i odgovore koji im mogu pomoći u njihovim ličnim kako da pitanjima.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Štafeta
programme.desc: Štafeta je emisija Una televizije koja povezuje glasove ljudi iz svih država bivše Jugoslavije, otvarajući prostor za dijalog, razmenu mišljenja i suočavanje različitih pogleda na teme koje nas jednako dotiču. U vremenu kada nas svakodnevica često deli granicama, politikom i različitim interpretacijama prošlosti, Štafeta podseća da region i dalje deli iste emocije, dileme i iskustva. Svaka epizoda donosi jednu centralnu temu – od kulture, muzike i medija do identiteta, društvenih pitanja i života običnih ljudi. Kroz razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima iz Srbije, Hrvatske, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Severne Makedonije i Slovenije, emisija gradi prostor u kojem svako ima pravo na svoj glas. Štafeta ne traži nužno zajednički odgovor, već iskren razgovor i pokušaj da se region ponovo čuje – bez buke, predrasuda i granica.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kris odlučuje da obitelj treba "komunikacijsku terapiju" nakon što se posvađa s djevojkama, ali planovi joj se obiju o glavu kad propusti jednu seansu.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Obitelj donosi veliku odluku o budućnosti serije. Kris odlazi na putovanje s djevojkama kako bi se opustila od tih odluka.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Khloè nailazi na neke neočekivane prepreke. Scott se brine da će se obitelj razdvojiti, jer se serija bliži kraju.

programme.title: Gledaj što se događa: Uživo s Andyjem Cohenom
programme.desc: Živahne rasprave o najvrućim temama iz pop kulture sa slavnim osobama i protagonistima reality emisija. Gosti iz najpopularnijih serija i druge šoubiz zvijezde razgovaraju o poznatim licima iz vijesti...

programme.title: Vrlo Cavallari
programme.desc: U finalu sezone, Kristin je bačena usred intenzivne svađe između Brittainy i Reagan. Jay poduzima sljedeći korak prema novoj avanturi.

programme.title: Vrlo Cavallari
programme.desc: Very Cavallari' je opet tu! Kristinin posao cvate, dok Brittainyn radni život ide dobro, ali njena veza sa Stoneom je klimava.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Djevojke Kardashian izazivaju Jennere na stazu s preprekama, kako bi jednom zauvijek utvrdile koja je strana obitelji više sportska.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kim i Khloé su znatiželjne zbog novog Kourtneyevog prijatelja. Uplašena od stanja u svijetu, Kim poduzima mjere kako bi se pripremila za budućnost.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Znajući da je u njenoj obitelji ranije bilo oboljelih od tumora, Kris želi da djevojke obave genetski test i upoznaju se s rizicima, ali ne slažu se svi s tim.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kris odlučuje da obitelj treba "komunikacijsku terapiju" nakon što se posvađa s djevojkama, ali planovi joj se obiju o glavu kad propusti jednu seansu.

programme.title: Vrlo Cavallari
programme.desc: U finalu sezone, Kristin je bačena usred intenzivne svađe između Brittainy i Reagan. Jay poduzima sljedeći korak prema novoj avanturi.

programme.title: Vrlo Cavallari
programme.desc: Very Cavallari' je opet tu! Kristinin posao cvate, dok Brittainyn radni život ide dobro, ali njena veza sa Stoneom je klimava.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: S još samo nekoliko preostalih dana u raju, Kendall i Kylie nastoje izgladiti razmirice, dok Kim i Khloé pomažu Kourtney da zaboravi Scotta.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kourtney nije spremna za lansiranje proizvoda u New Yorku, a sestre joj daju do znanja kako je vrijeme da se usredotoči na to. Kim daje Kylie poneki savjet.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kourtney postavlja granice, Caitlyn se obraća Kris za pomoć, a Khloé i Tristan imaju neobjašnjivo iskustvo dok tragaju za vanzemaljcima.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama

Hit List
programme.desc: Charlotte is a woman with anger management issues whose therapist suggests she write a journal to keep her emotions in check. Unlucky in love, she ventures online to find a boyfriend. Just as she reaches her limit of unsuccessful dates, Charlotte meets her soul mate Lyle. Everything is perfect until Lyle finds Charlottes journal and sets out to prove just how deeply he loves her.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: The Prize Winner of Defiance, Ohio
Death Defying Acts
programme.desc: On a tour of Britain in 1926, Harry Houdini enters into a passionate affair with a psychic out to con the famous magician.

programme.title: Risen
programme.desc: The Rise of a True British Champion. Based on a true story. As a young man, Howard Winstone was one of the biggest rising talents in amateur boxing. Already with a number of schoolboy titles under his belt, the boy from Merthyr Tydfil, Wales, was fast making a name for himself with his knockout right hand. A career as a professional fighter beckoned. Being from a poor family and struggling to make ends meet, Howard helped out by working weekends in a toy factory. And it was there his dream effectively came to an end as a metal pressing machine malfunctioned and crushed Howard's fingers, injuring his right hand so severely he had to undergo amputation. He lost the tips of three fingers so his right hand could no longer make a proper fist. A depressed Howard seemingly lost everything. But his father wouldn't let him gripe and soon got him punching a coal bag to keep his spirits up. Then, under the guidance of a new trainer, Eddie Thomas, and with the support of his father, he started to learn a new style and once again began to rise up victoriously through the amateur ranks. By the time of his first professional fight, Howard had completely changed the way he boxed. Remarkably, he went on to become Champion of Britain and Champion of Europe. As with any person who achieves great things there is also a cost and Howard's was that of his marriage. At 16 he wed his childhood sweetheart, Bennita, who stood by him and had four beautiful children. But when pressures got too much for both of them the relationship came to a dramatic end. The dramatic finale culminates with Howard exceeding the hopes of an entire nation and being crowned Featherweight Champion of The World.

programme.title: First Dog
programme.desc: A foster boy is befriended by a lost dog who turns out to belong to the President of the United States. The boy decides to run away from the foster home to return the canine to the White House -- "Because it's the right thing to do!"

programme.title: Molly Moon and the Incredible Book of Hypnotism
programme.desc: Molly Moon finds a rare hypnosis book. She becomes adept at hypnotizing and uses this ability to become a superstar. But a mean professor is also interested in this book.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: Alex of Venice
programme.desc: A workaholic attorney is forced to reinvent her life after her husband suddenly leaves.

programme.title: Fighting Season
programme.desc: A fact-based movie going behind the scenes of recruiting soldiers for the US Army at the end of the first decade of the 21st century. In this rough time, so unfavourable for the soldiery, enlisting volunteers required non-standard actions and some methods of military recruiters could be considered controversial.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: A story of a young girl who lives in the Swiss Alps with her goat herding Grandfather.

programme.title: Whisper Island
programme.desc: Sam Dalton, a 14-year-old girl, is determined to save the only home she has ever known, the faded, dusty Romanian Princess ranch. Sam writes to a distant relative of her Aunt Christine hoping he can prevent the ranch from being repossessed. But it's J. T. Swinton, a teenage boy who shows up. In desperation they turn to a seemingly futile hope, the treasure of Whisper Island. But does the Civil War treasure really exist? The answer seems to be trapped somewhere in the wishful delusions of Aunt Christine. As the teens search for treasure in a race against time, they must also search Christine's past and unravel a web of romance, intrigue and betrayal that spans a lifetime and beyond. What they find, changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Hard Ball
programme.desc: When a compulsive gambler (Keanu Reeves) is unable to pay a debt he owes to his friend, he is given the choice to payback the debt by coaching an inner-city little league baseball team. Taking on this new challenge gives him a new outlook on life, as well as the kids on the team. Based upon the book, "Hardball: A Season in the Projects", by Daniel Coyle.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman

programme.desc: Molly Moon finds a rare hypnosis book. She becomes adept at hypnotizing and uses this ability to become a superstar. But a mean professor is also interested in this book.

programme.title: Pretty Ugly People
programme.desc: Lucy (Missi Pyle) has battled obesity her entire life and with the 'little time she has left," she wants to spend a final weekend together with her best college friends like once remembered. Upon arriving, Lucy's friends soon discover that, Lucy isn't actually dying. On the flip side, Lucy soon realizes her friends are now a far cry from the "Pretty and Perfect" friends whom she had remembered and that her final wish wasn't the best of ideas after all. The group soon finds themselves on a four-day hike stripped of modern conveniences and with no place to hide. The winding uphill trail brings to surface everyone's inner demons and fears, with each member of the group taking something away from the adventure that they could never have imagined.

Pošto se ne može osloniti na to da će državni organi sprovesti zakon, on kreće da pronađe svoju porodicu i osveti se za nasilje koje je nad njima počinjeno.

Postepeno, Džek i Rebeka se zaljubljuju uprkos protivljenju Rebekine sestre Bedelije, koja je u detinjstvu, kao žrtva incesta, razvila patološku mržnju prema muškarcima. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Njuškalo u ratu
programme.desc: Nakon što su mu roditelji poginuli u bombardovanju tokom Drugog svetskog rata, Tomas u poslali da živi s rođacima na seoskoj farmi u Holandiji. On je tužan, ljut i uplašen i prezire što mora da živi sa tetkom i tečom.Ali kad Tom dobije da gaju nemačkog ovčara Njuškala, sve se iz korena menja. On sve svoje poverenje poklanja Njuškalu i zajedno se trude da izvuku najbolje od života iako je njihovo selo pod nemačkom kontrolom.Uz Njuškalovu pomoć Tom spasava holandskog pilota koji je oboren i ranjen. Ali kada holandski nacistički kolaboracionista pošalje vojnike da traže pilota, na Njuškalu i Tomu je da razotkriju izdajnika. Pilot uspeva da pobegne u svoju jedinicu, a Njuškalo nazad dovodi vojsku kako bi oslobodili grad."Njuškalo u ratu" je dostupno u dve verzije, kao dugometražni igrani film ili kao mini-serija od četiri polučasovne epizode.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje

Kada Joan odluči prodati izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Paige to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži posljednju šansu — ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da nitko, pa ni Daniel, posljednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena obitelj predstavlja prijetnju.

Meri sa svojim verenikom Brentom odlučuje da otputuje kod svoje porodice u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću, Brent dobija napad alergije koji ga sprečava da krene na put. Meri odlučuje da sa sobom povede Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca, koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora, i predstavi ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.title: Božićni poljubac
programme.desc: Poznata dekoraterka Prisila Hal i njena asistentkinja Vendi utrkuju se za pažnju Prisilinog popularnog dečka dok uređuju njegovu kuću za praznike

programme.title: Poslednja potera
programme.desc: Godine 1909, Vili Boj i njegova voljena Karlota beže nakon što on u kobnom sukobu slučajno usmrti njenog oca. Dok se predsednik Taft sprema da poseti ovu oblast, lokalni šerif i dvojica indijanskih tragača kreću u poteru za čovekom kog smatraju ubicom svog plemenskog vođe.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Skoro prijatelji
programme.desc: Čarli, neambiciozni muškarac u srednjim dvadesetim godinama koji i dalje živi s majkom i očuhom i zaljubljuje se u mladu ženu koja je u vezi s ozbiljnim muškarcem.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Film je u celosti smešten u večeri u kojoj se odvija premijerno izvođenje srednjoškolske postavke Šekspirovog "Sna letnje noći". Film "Premijera" je hronika katastrofalnih dešavanja na sceni, kao i drame koju iza scene preživljavaju neki od učenika, njihov profesor književnosti i gostujuća zvezda B produkcije.

programme.title: Uništiteljka
programme.desc: Policijska detektivka ponovo se nalazi sa ljudima s kojima je davno radila na tajnom zadatku, kako bi među njima konačno došlo do pomirenja.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Se-jon, vlasnica kafića koja sama odgaja ćerku posle muževljeve smrti, suočava se sa zagonetnim pozivima sa "skrivenog broja". Psihijatrica Eun-su daje sirove savete Jung-von, dok Hva-jong, službenica u advokatskoj kancelariji, prati klijentkinjinog muža i nailazi na nešto neočekivano.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Andy Hardy goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart is engaged to someone else.

programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Songwriter and Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern is unable to find immediate success in the U.S. He sought recognition abroad. He journeyed to England where his dreams of success became real and where he met his future wife Eva Leale.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: The Terror of Tiny Town
programme.desc: Using a conventional Western story with an all dwarf cast, the filmmakers were able to showcase gags such as cowboys entering the local saloon by walking under the swinging doors, and pint-sized cowboys galloping around on Shetland ponies while roping calves.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: Sixty Glorious Years
programme.desc: Picking up where Victoria the Great (1937) left off, this sequel to the 1937 film has Anna Neagle return to the role of Queen Victoria in another colorful account of the revered British monarch's reign.

programme.title: Bella Vista
programme.desc: A film about place and belonging.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.

programme.title: The Passionate Plumber
programme.desc: Paris plumber Elmer Tuttle is enlisted by socialite Patricia Alden to help make her lover Tony Lagorce jealous. With the help of his friend Julius J. McCracken and through the high society contacts he has made through Patricia, Elmer hopes to find financing for his latest invention, a pistol with a range-finding light. Comic complications ensue when Elmer's effort to interest a military leader is misconstrued as an assassination attempt.

programme.title: Hitler: Beast of Berlin
programme.desc: Hans Memling, a young intellectual, patriotic German, is secretly opposed to the Nazi regime. With the aid of Gustav Schultz, Father Pommer, Anna Wahl and others, he is gleaning accurate information from foreign radio broadcasts and distributing it through Germany with an underground-press operation.

programme.title: John Wayne Stagecoach Run
programme.desc: John Wayne explodes across the screen in this action-packed tale of deceit _ and revenge. In a dilapidated ghost town, John Blair (Wayne) runs afoul of the villainous Drake who attempts to cheat him out of a lucrative mail delivery contract. It all leads to a thrilling race in the gorgeous Sacramento Valley. Stagecoach Run has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time!

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Newly married Kay Dunstan announces that she and her husband are having a baby, leaving her father to come to grips with the fact that he will soon be a granddad.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: John Wayne Cold Vengeance
programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: A Shriek in the Night
programme.desc: Rival newspaper reporters Pat Morgan and Ted Rand find themselves unraveling the mystery behind the death of a millionaire philanthropist who fell from his penthouse balcony. When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A widow deceives her late husband's mother and brothers into thinking he's still alive when she attends the yearly memorial to his drowned sister, hoping to secure his inheritance, but her cunning is no match for the demented, axe-wielding thing roaming the grounds of the family's Irish estate.

programme.title: Lady of Burlesque
programme.desc: After one member of their group is murdered, the performers at a burlesque house must work together to find out who the killer is before they strike again.

programme.title: Someone Behind the Door
programme.desc: A neurosurgeon with a cheating wife takes an amnesiac into his home and conditions him to believe that the cheating wife is his own and to take the "appropriate" action.

programme.title: Someone Behind the Door
programme.desc: A neurosurgeon with a cheating wife takes an amnesiac into his home and conditions him to believe that the cheating wife is his own and to take the "appropriate" action.

programme.title: John Wayne Guns Along the Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne is back, doing what he does best _ slingin' guns and throwing fists in this action-packed tale of intrigue in the Wild West. John Wyatt (Wayne) is a government agent who must go undercover in a traveling medicine show to infiltrate a dangerous gang of counterfeiters. Guns Along the Trail has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: The Stranger Within a Woman
programme.desc: Two friends meet in a bar. Later that night, one friend's flirtatious wife is reportedly in an accident. The other friend doesn't feel well. What's come over him?

programme.title: The Admiral Was a Lady
programme.desc: Ex-WAVE encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.

programme.title: Night Light
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy is about to go and live with his mother in the city. Before leaving his hometown, he has to confront his father's inability to give him an integrated family.

programme.title: The Navigator
programme.desc: The wealthy and impulsive Rollo Treadway decides to propose to his beautiful socialite neighbor, Betsy O'Brien. Although Betsy turns Rollo down, he still opts to go on the cruise that he intended as their honeymoon.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Imprisoned for a murder he did not commit, John Brant escapes and ends up out west where, after giving the local lawmen the slip, he joins up with an outlaw gang. Brant finds out that 'Jones', one of the outlaws he has become friends with, committed the murder that Brant was sent up for, but has no knowledge that anyone was ever put in jail for his crime. Willing to forgive and forget, Brant doesn't realize that "Jones" has not only fallen for the same pretty shopgirl Brant has, but begins to suspect that Brant is not truly an outlaw.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: A convicted thief in Dartmoor prison hides the location of the stolen Bank of England printing plates inside three music boxes. When the innocent purchasers of the boxes start to be murdered, Holmes and Watson investigate.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Bride
programme.desc: Hugh "Bulldog" Drummond is on the precipice of matrimony to his beloved Phyllis -- but a bank robbery and a daring escape is going to get in their way before they reach the altar.

programme.title: Private Buckaroo
programme.desc: A rebellious young inductee has trouble toeing the line until he meets a retired officer's lovely daughter. James and his band are also drafted and decide to perk up their camp by putting on a big show.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: Champagne Safari
programme.desc: Travelogue/documentary follows newly married Rita Hayworth and Prince Aly Khan on their honeymoon trip through exotic locales.

programme.title: Call the Mesquiteers
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers are forced to track down a train robbery ring after some of the gang hijack their truck for a getaway and the police conclude they are part of the gang, an identification which is just fine with the gang's nameless chief.

programme.title: King of the Zombies
programme.desc: During World War II, a small plane somewhere over the Caribbean runs low on fuel and is blown off course by a storm. Guided by a faint radio signal, they crash-land on an island. The passenger, his manservant and the pilot take refuge in a mansion owned by a doctor. The quick-witted yet easily-frightened manservant soon becomes convinced the mansion is haunted by zombies and ghosts.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: The Monster Maker
programme.desc: Mad scientist injects his enemies with acromegaly virus, causing them to become hideously deformed.

programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Chris Morrell, the guardian of half-Indian girl Nina, is helping her find her missing white father. so she can cash in on her late mother's oil lease. Outlaw Sam Black is after the girl and her father as well. Besides dealing with the Black gang, Morrell has to find another robber, Jim Moore, who switches clothes with him after he finds Chris unconscious from a fight with Sam Black. Along the way, he meets a lady who's the sister of Jim Moore, another bad hombre who's in cahoots with Jim Moore, and an old friend who takes in Nina and helps Chris locate Nina's father and fight off the various desperadoes

programme.title: Nancy Drew... Reporter
programme.desc: While participating in a contest at a local newspaper in which school children are asked to submit a news story, local attorney Carson Drew's daughter Nancy intercepts a real story assignment. She "covers" the inquest of the death of a woman who was poisoned. Nancy doesn't think the young woman accused of the crime is guilty and corrals her neighbor Ted into searching for a vital piece of evidence and stumbles onto the identity of the real killer.

programme.title: Nancy Drew... Reporter

programme.title: Badge of Honor
programme.desc: Bob Gordon comes from a rich background but wants make it on his own. He dreams of becoming a newspaper reporter and he eventually gets his chance.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: Her Lonely Lane
programme.desc: Fumiko struggles to get her literary work published, spending years working in poverty while being abused by her boyfriend all the while hoping to break free from the cycle.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: The Water
programme.desc: A man wakes up in a world where the water has disappeared. There's no water in the pipes nor in the bottles. Not even one drop falls from the clouds. The sea itself has become a desert. However, everyone acts as if nothing happened. In the bars they sip from empty glasses, from a springboard a diver falls into a dry pool. Alone, the protagonist realizes the incredible disappearance _ and nobody pays attention to him.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Terror by Night
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: The tranquility of a small town is marred only by sheriff Tod Shaw's unsuccessful courtship of widow Ellen Benson, a pacifist who can't abide guns and those who use them. But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: The End of Summer
programme.desc: The family of an older man who runs a small sake brewery become concerned with his finances and his health after they discover him visiting an old mistress from his youth.

programme.title: The Fast and the Furious
programme.desc: A trucker framed for murder breaks out of jail, takes a young woman hostage, and enters her sports car in cross-border road race hoping to get to Mexico before the police catch him.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: The Harvest
programme.desc: Thousands of foreign workers support today the most known Italian excellence: agri-food production. A docu-musical shows their daily exploitation.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: Career Girl
programme.desc: Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.

programme.title: Go West
programme.desc: With little luck at keeping a job in the city a New Yorker tries work in the country and eventually finds his way leading a herd of cattle to the West Coast.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island

programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg: Brazil
programme.desc: Andre je usamljeni čovek koji je veći deo svog života proveo pokušavajući da udovolji drugima. Gojaznost ga je ograničavala na mnogo načina.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks _ without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better. Shark advocates Dr. Erich Ritter and Chuck Anderson have grave reservations about how far we are willing to go for a thrill. And they have intimate knowledge of the subject. Both men were brutally attacked by bull sharks. Shark Divers also examines the controversy surrounding a handful of high-profile attacks in 2008, including the first shark tourist killed while on a shark excursion.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester's team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your kicks on Route 66 in Flagstaff, AZ. Duck and cover! We're headed to the famous Barringer meteor crater outside of town. Then we scan the stars for heavenly bodies at Lowell Observatory. We'll learn the history of the region at the Northern Arizona History Museum, and finally swing from their many ponderosa pines at Flagstaff Extreme adventure park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We're headed upstate to Albany and Saratoga Springs. We'll take the Albany capital tour and see five former NY governors who would become US Presidents. Then, we'll board the USS Slater and see how America defended its fleet against German U-boats in WWII. We'll sample the mineral water in Saratoga Springs, and bet the farm at their famous thoroughbred raceway. Then, we'll learn how important the Battle of Saratoga was for America's future at Saratoga battlefield.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Several of the world's best kayakers are led by South African legend, Steve Fisher, on a trip down one of the most difficult rivers in the world.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: The best all-round snowboarder and skier in the world, explore and assault the southern alps of New Zealand looking for big air and beautiful light to kick off another winter season.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. With confidence scientists now calculated there could be as many as 40 billion Earth like planets in our Milky Way galaxy alone.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: Quirky Science

Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell's principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore fire—a force both friend and foe. Mastered by humans hundreds of thousands of years ago, fire remains as inevitable as wind or rain, yet deadly when uncontrolled. Disasters can strike anywhere: from a Brussels department store to a Rhode Island nightclub where pyrotechnics killed 100 people. Firefighters still charge into danger, hauling hoses, scaling stairs with heavy tools, and lifting 35-foot ladders to save lives.
