programme.title: Crni demon, film
programme.desc: Idilični obiteljski odmor naftnog magnata Paula Sturgesa (Lucas) pretvori se u noćnu moru kada se iz dubina oceana pojavi masivni megalodon poznat po imenu: Crni demon, koji je spreman učiniti sve kako bi zaštitio svoj teritorij. Nasukani i pod stalnim napadima, Paul i njegova obitelj moraju nekako pronaći način kako se vratiti na kopno prije nego što ih ponovno napadne u ovoj epskoj bitci između čovjeka i prirode.

programme.title: Gospodin Brooks, film
programme.desc: Kevin Costner glumi Earla Brooksa, čovjeka čija naizgled savršena obitelj i status u društvu skrivaju ružnu tajnu. Brooks konstantno izgovara molitvu ovisnika – Molitva spokoja – ali on nije u raljama droge ili alkohola. Umjesto toga, njegova uredna kravata pokriva želudac žedan krvi. Iako je odolijevao toj želji dvije godine, ona se vratila zahvaljujući naporima njegovog zlog unutarnjeg glasa (William Hurt). Na djelu ga je uhvatio čovjek koji sam sebe naziva g. Smith (Dane Cook), ali g. Smith ne želi prijaviti Brooksa. Ljigavi amater fotograf želi učiti iz Brooksova metodičkog pristupa te i sam postati ubojicom. U međuvremenu, okorjela policajka (Demi Moore) ganja čovjeka odgovornog za smrti po cijelom Portlandu dok se nosi i s problemima u privatnom životu.

programme.title: Vražja dostava, film
programme.desc: Vremena su teška za Samanthu. Njen prvi dan kao dostavljačice pizze ne ide prema planu. Na kraju dugog dana i nedovoljno napojnica, ispada da je posljednja isporuka namijenjena skupini bogatih sotonista koji traže djevičansku žrtvu. Sada u borbi za svoj život, Sam se mora braniti od vještica, zlih uroka i demonskih stvorenja, sve dok pokušava zadržati svoje tijelo - i dušu - netaknutima

programme.title: Čarobni prolaz, film
programme.desc: Uzbudljiva i živopisna avantura odvest će vašu obitelj u morske dubine, u krajolike očaravajuće ljepote, ali i velike opasnosti. Priča prati mladog dupina bujne mašte i njegovog najboljeg prijatelja koji neprestano otkrivaju nova mjesta za istraživanje - pronalaze brojne čarobne predmete, za koje nitko ne vjeruje da su zapravo stvarni. Jednog dana otkriju čarobni prolaz koji ih može pretvoriti u ono što žele postati. Nažalost, jegulje su otkrile njihovu tajnu i odlučili su prolaz iskoristiti za preuzimanje Ribljeg grada. Kako priča napreduje, dupini se moraju utrkivati s vremenom kako bi spasili svoj grad. S nizom ljupkih detalja, odličnim glumcima koji su sinkronizirali film i, dakako, savršenom najmodernijom tehnikom animacije, ovaj film pravo je uživanje za oči i osjećaje.

programme.title: Devet života, film
programme.desc: Tom Brand je milijarder, radoholičar, na vrhuncu svoje karijere. Međutim, taj način života udaljio ga je od njegove prekrasne žene i kćeri Rebecce. Bliži se jedanaesti rođendan njegove kćeri i ono što je oduvijek htjela, bila je mačka, koju nikada nije dobila. Tom mrzi mačke, ali kako mu vrijeme za kupovinu poklona ističe, odluči se na kupovinu mačke. U toj potrazi završi u mističnom dućanu s ekscentričnim vlasnikom - Felixom Perkinsom (Christopher Walken), koji mu predstavlja veličanstvenu mačku, zvanu Mr. Fuzzypants. Na putu da donese kćeri ljubimca iz snova dogodi se nešto bizarno te se Tom nađe zarobljen u tijelu gospodina Fuzzypants. Usvojen od svoje obitelji kao mačka Fuzzypants, Tom počinje gledati na svoj život i obitelj drugim očima.

programme.title: Devet života, film
programme.desc: Tom Brand je milijarder, radoholičar, na vrhuncu svoje karijere. Međutim, taj način života udaljio ga je od njegove prekrasne žene i kćeri Rebecce. Bliži se jedanaesti rođendan njegove kćeri i ono što je oduvijek htjela, bila je mačka, koju nikada nije dobila. Tom mrzi mačke, ali kako mu vrijeme za kupovinu poklona ističe, odluči se na kupovinu mačke. U toj potrazi završi u mističnom dućanu s ekscentričnim vlasnikom - Felixom Perkinsom (Christopher Walken), koji mu predstavlja veličanstvenu mačku, zvanu Mr. Fuzzypants. Na putu da donese kćeri ljubimca iz snova dogodi se nešto bizarno te se Tom nađe zarobljen u tijelu gospodina Fuzzypants. Usvojen od svoje obitelji kao mačka Fuzzypants, Tom počinje gledati na svoj život i obitelj drugim očima.

programme.title: Tri mušketira: D'Artagnan, film
programme.desc: Nevjerojatna, herojska priča, govori o mladiću po imenu d'Artagnan koji od kuće odlazi u Pariz, nadajući se da će postati mušketir garde. Unatoč neuspješnoj regrutaciji, on ipak postaje dio trojice najdojmljivijih mušketira - Athosa, Aramisa i Portosa - i ubrzo se uklopi u njihov način života. U kraljevstvu podijeljenom vjerskim ratovima i pod prijetnjom britanske invazije, šačica muškaraca i žena ukrstit će mačeve i vezati svoju sudbinu za sudbinu Francuske.

programme.title: Tri mušketira: Milady, film
programme.desc: Roman Alexandra Dumasa književni je klasik koji je već nekoliko puta ekraniziran za velika platna, no ova raskošna adaptacija predstavlja nove likove i brojne lokacije, od slavnog Louvrea do Buckinghamske palače, preko oluka Pariza do opsade La Rochellea... D'Artagnan je prisiljen udružiti snage s Milady kako bi spasio Constance, koja je oteta pred njegovim očima. No kako je rat najavljen, a Athos, Porthos i Aramis već su se pridružili fronti, tajna iz prošlosti razbija stare saveze.

programme.title: Tri mušketira: Milady, film
programme.desc: Roman Alexandra Dumasa književni je klasik koji je već nekoliko puta ekraniziran za velika platna, no ova raskošna adaptacija predstavlja nove likove i brojne lokacije, od slavnog Louvrea do Buckinghamske palače, preko oluka Pariza do opsade La Rochellea... programme.title: Tajna u njihovim očima, film
programme.desc: Dobro uigran trio istražitelja - policajci Ray Karsten (C. Ejiofor) i Jess Cobb (J. Roberts), te pomoćnica javnog tužitelja Claire Sloan (N. Kidman) - razilazi se nakon brutalnog i neobjašnjivog ubojstva Jessine tinejdžerske kćeri. 13 godina poslije, nakon što je sve vrijeme neumorno tragao za ubojicom, Ray napokon dolazi do otkrića za koje je siguran da može razriješiti cijeli slučaj i strpati ubojicu iza rešetaka. No nitko nije spreman na šokantnu i nepojmljivu tajnu koja se počinje razotkrivati...

programme.title: Kad zlo vreba, film
programme.desc: Kad braća Pedro i Jimmy otkriju da se demonski opsjednut muškarac nalazi u obližnjoj seoskoj kući i truje mjesnu stoku, pokušavaju ga istjerati sa svoje zemlje. Budući da se ne pridržavaju obreda egzorcizma, nepromišljenim postupcima izazivaju epidemiju opsjednutosti u svojoj ruralnoj zajednici. Sada moraju pobjeći zlu i zatražiti pomoć "čistača" koji jedini može zaustaviti ovu nadnaravnu pošast.

programme.title: Oldboy, film
programme.desc: Remake istoimenog kultnog južnokorejskog hita iz 2003.g. u režiji slavnoga Spikea Leeja. Stručnjak za oglašavanje Joe Doucett (Josh Brolin) je ženskaroš, alkoholičar i loš otac kćeri koja živi s njegovom bivšom suprugom. Jednoga dana Joe se budi zatočen u motelskoj sobi bez telefona koja će postati njegov zatvor narednih 20 godina. Početni očaj zbog vijesti da mu je supruga ubijena i da je on optužen za to ubojstvo zamjenjuje Joeova usredotočenost da izađe iz zatočeništva i pronađe tamničara. Počinje trenirati gledajući emisije o fitnesu, kung fu filmove i UFC mečeve na TV-u i pretvara se u smrtonosno oružje spremno na osvetu, a onda ga odjednom neobjašnjivo oslobode...

programme.title: Između života i smrti, film
programme.desc: Nakon strašne automobilske nesreće, Anna (Ricci) budi se i ugleda pogrebnika Eliota Deacona (Neeson) kako priprema njezino tijelo za pokop.Zbunjena, u strahu, no još uvijek osjećaja da je živa, Anna ne vjeruje da je mrtva. Uhvaćena je između života i smrti… i pogrebnika koji se čini da ima dar nadilaženja smrti, ali možda je samo želi pokopati živu.

programme.title: Izum, film
programme.desc: Danju, mala grupa inženjera radi za veliku korporaciju. Noću, provode opite u svojoj garaži. Razvijajući svoj najnoviji projekt, slučajno otkriju neočekivane mogućnosti… mogu raditi i dobiti sve što zamisle. Iskoristiti ovu priliku prvi je izazov s kojim se suočavaju. Suočavanje s posljedicama moglo bi im biti i posljednji.

programme.title: Vili Kočnica, film
programme.desc: U imaginarnom svijetu u kojem su građani automobili, jedan taksi će postati kralj ceste u svom rodnom gradu. Ubrzo otkriva da je veća prednost ostati vjeran sebi nego biti slavan. Kada mu zaprijete veliki kamioni, hoće li im se žuti, lokalni taxi moći usprotiviti i postati globalni heroj?

programme.title: Mali genijalac, film
programme.desc: Temeljena na popularnom i kod nas neprevedenom debitantskom romanu "Odabrana djela T. V. Spiveta" američkog književnika Reifa Larsena, pustolovna obiteljska drama Mali genijalac redatelja Jeana-Pierrea Jeuneta (Amélie) s Helenom Bonham Carter u sporednoj ulozi, priča je o bistrom desetogodišnjem klincu T. S. Spivetu, darovitom izumitelju i strastvenom kartografu koji, primivši obavijest o osvajanju važne nagrade i govoru koji mora održati na Smithsonian institutu u Washingtonu, s obiteljske farme u Montani kreće na put oboružan teleskopom i kompasima.

programme.title: Svemir između nas, film
programme.desc: U svemirskoj avanturi, space shuttle kreće u prvu misiju kolonizacije Marsa, no odmah nakon polijetanja saznaju da je jedna astronautkinja trudna. Ubrzo nakon slijetanja ona umire od komplikacija prilikom rađanja prvog čovjeka na crvenom planetu - ne otkrivši tko mu je otac. Tako počinje neobičan život Gardnera Elliota. U istraživanju svog porijekla Gardner započinje online prijateljstvo s djevojkom iz Colorada, Tulsom. Kad napokon dobije priliku otići na Zemlju poželi isprobati sva čuda o kojima je mogao čitati na Marsu. No kada znanstvenici počnu s pripremom za njegov odlazak otkriju da njegovi organi ne mogu izdržati u Zemljinoj atmosferi…

programme.title: Glasovi, film
programme.desc: Jerryju očajnički treba prijatelj. Uz pomoć sudski dodijeljenog psihijatra on pokušava ostvariti nešto sa svojom uredskom simpatijom. No, ona će ga iznevjeriti. U pratnji svojih pričajućih ljubimaca, zle mačke i benovalentnog psa, on će izabrati jedan put. Hoće li to biti normalnost ili pak neki posve šašavi izbor?

programme.title: Glasovi, film

programme.title: Boss Level, film
programme.desc: Umirovljeni vojni specijalac Roy Pulver (F. Grillo) iznova proživljava jedan te isti dan koji uvijek završava njegovom brutalnom smrću od strane nepoznatih mu plaćenika ili prilikom bježanja od istih. Svakim novim buđenjem nakon likvidacije, Roy skuplja djelić po djelić informacija koja bi ga trebala dovesti do odgovora tko ga želi ubiti i zašto se neprestano vraća iz mrtvih te ponavlja taj kobni dan? … Ispravljajući stvari, Roy može postati najbolja verzija sebe - ako se može spasiti od ponovne smrti.

programme.title: Brod strave, film
programme.desc: Kasnonoćna vožnja trajektom pretvara se u noćnu moru kada ubojiti i nestašni miš po imenu Willie započne krvavi kaos među nesretnim putnicima!

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Kada je tijelo Kathleen Lipscomb pronađeno na sporednoj cesti izvan San Antonija u Teksasu 1986., policija se bori da identificira ubojicu i slučaj miruje nekoliko godina.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Robert Neulander
programme.desc: Dr Bob Neulander pronašao je svoju suprugu Leslie prekrivenu krvlju u kupaonici, nakon što je očito pala. U početku je njezina smrt proglašena nesretnim slučajem, no zbog lokalnih glasina tužiteljstvo je ponovno otvorilo istragu.

programme.title: Ubojstva tijekom proljetnih praznika, Tynesha Stewart
programme.desc: 19-godišnja Tynesha Stewart studira građevinarstvo i vraća se kući u Houston kako bi vidjela obitelj i prijatelje na proljetnim praznicima. Također ima velike planove posjetiti Beyoncéin koncert, ali Tynesha se nikad ne pojavljuje na nastupu.

programme.title: Ubojstvo u motelu, Ubojstvo u župi
programme.desc: Šerifov ured u DeRidderu prima uznemirujući telefonski poziv od vlasnika Dee's Motela. Muškarac im govori da je pronašao ženu mrtvu u sobi 6. Policija pronalazi krvavu scenu koja ukazuje da je žena bila žrtva brutalnog napada.

programme.title: Ubojstvo u motelu, Ubojstvo u župi
programme.desc: Šerifov ured u DeRidderu prima uznemirujući telefonski poziv od vlasnika Dee's Motela. Muškarac im govori da je pronašao ženu mrtvu u sobi 6. Policija pronalazi krvavu scenu koja ukazuje da je žena bila žrtva brutalnog napada.

programme.title: Spoj, vjenčanje, ubojstvo, Malcolm Webster
programme.desc: Ova ekskluzivna serija o stvarnim zločinima bavi se najčešćim oblikom ubojstva - kada jedan supružnik ubije drugoga. Kad je žrtva ubojstva žena, veća je vjerojatnost da je ubojica suprug nego bilo tko drugi.

programme.title: Prvih 48 sati, serija
programme.desc: Nakon što je 14-godišnji dječak ubijen ispred prijateljeve kuće, detektivi se pitaju je li se našao usred zlokobne zavjere.

programme.title: Gradski dosjei, Ponoćna tragedija u Georgiji
programme.desc: Blagdansko raspoloženje gotovo nestaje iz Mariette kada je jedan od njezinih najveselijih stanovnika pronađen ubijen u vlastitom domu. Kako bi riješila misterij, policija se oslanja na pomoć stanovnika koji pomažu razotkriti opasnu zavjeru.

programme.title: Gradski dosjei, Strava u Gradu bourbona
programme.desc: Nekada mirna poljoprivredna zajednica potresena je kada je jedan od njihovih brutalno ubijen. Gotovo godinu dana policija ne uspijeva riješiti misterij, dok sretni preokret ne usmjeri detektive prema grupi neočekivanih osvetnika.

programme.title: Gradski dosjei, Strava u Gradu bourbona
programme.desc: Nekada mirna poljoprivredna zajednica potresena je kada je jedan od njihovih brutalno ubijen. Gotovo godinu dana policija ne uspijeva riješiti misterij, dok sretni preokret ne usmjeri detektive prema grupi neočekivanih osvetnika.

programme.title: Gradski dosjei, Ubojstvo u Malom Haitiju
programme.desc: Devedesetih godina haićanska zajednica u Spring Valleyju potresena je kada je ubijen cijenjeni građanski vođa. Policiji će trebati gotovo dva desetljeća da razdvoji glasine od istine i riješi misterij pun laži i mračnih tajni.

programme.title: Gradski dosjei, Progonitelj iz Kansasa
programme.desc: Popularni spasilac pronađen je mrtav u zajedničkom bazenu, izazivajući val straha u Leawoodu, Kansas. Nepoznati muškarac, sumnjivo vozilo i odlučan otac pomažu policiji u istrazi kako bi pronašli ubojicu.

programme.title: Suncem obasjana ubojstva
programme.desc: Kada se poruke za dvoje bogatih ljubitelja sunca počnu gomilati u njihovom luksuznom hotelu u Acapulcu, policija izviđa područje - ali ključni trag dolazi iz pisma poslanog kući.

programme.title: Ubojstva tijekom proljetnih praznika, Lynda Shaw
programme.desc: Kada je 21-godišnja studentica strojarstva Lynda Shaw oteta i ubijena, istražitelji u Ontariju, Kanada, ispituju desetke osumnjičenih, uključujući jednog od najpoznatijih serijskih ubojica zemlje. Slučaj potom ostaje neriješen.

programme.title: Ubojstvo u motelu, Ludo ubojstvo
programme.desc: Zamjenici šerifovog odjela okruga Riverside dolaze kod napuštenog vozila u udaljenom području brda Gavilan. Istražitelji su šokirani otkrićem okrutnih leševa dvojice muškaraca naguranih u prtljažnik automobila.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Kada istaknuti milijunaš Gary Triano 1996. godine bude ubijen od eksplozije automobila bombe ispred luksuznog golf kluba u Tucsonu u Arizoni, svi znakovi upućuju na to da su ga njegovi sumnjivi poslovni partneri napali zbog neplaćenih dugova.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Yolanda Saldivar
programme.desc: Pop zvijezda u usponu upucana je. Budućnost je svijetla za Selenu Quintanillu dok joj menadžerica Yolanda Saldivar ne oduzme sve. Što tjera njezinu navodnu najveću obožavateljicu da postane njezin ubojica?

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Vickie Jackson
programme.desc: Tijekom samo nekoliko mjeseci, Vickie Jackson ubila je najmanje deset ljudi. Istraga je pronašla sumnjivu špricu u smeću Jacksonove, a tijela su ekshumirana kako bi se testirala smrtonosna droga.

programme.title: Spoj, vjenčanje, ubojstvo, Chacey Poynter
programme.desc: Bob Poynter mogao je biti Chaceyjin otac. A bio je i u braku. No za nju su sve to bile tek manje zapreke. Međutim, kad je njihov odnos došao u krizu, Chacey je angažirala drugog ljubavnika da brutalno okonča brak.

programme.title: Spoj, vjenčanje, ubojstvo, Ann Marie Anastasi
programme.desc: Ova ekskluzivna serija o stvarnim zločinima bavi se najčešćim oblikom ubojstva - kada jedan supružnik ubije drugoga. Kad je žrtva ubojstva žena, veća je vjerojatnost da je ubojica suprug nego bilo tko drugi.

programme.title: Sat vremena za ubojstvo, Mark i Sean Cavaness
programme.desc: Ponosni liječnik iz malog grada posjećuje svog sina pod izlikom ponovnog povezivanja, ali potajno mami svog sina u smrtonosni lažni osjećaj sigurnosti.

programme.title: Sat vremena za ubojstvo, Dean Frank
programme.desc: Naizgled jednostavan slučaj samoobrane komplicira slučaj istražiteljima kada forenzički dokazi otkriju da stvari nisu onakve kakvima se na prvu čine.

programme.title: Sat vremena za ubojstvo, Sydney Loofe
programme.desc: Sydney Loofe mlada je žena iz Nebraske koja traži romantičnu vezu. Upoznaje mladu ženu putem aplikacije za upoznavanje i njih dvije odmah kliknu. Ali je li ona zaista osoba kojom se predstavlja? Sydneyin nestanak pokreće potragu u više država.

programme.title: Sat vremena za ubojstvo, Summer Inman
programme.desc: Summer Inman zaštitarka je u banci u Ohiju koja radi noćnu smjenu. Na putu kući, dvojica muškaraca je omame i otmu u sporednoj uličici. U cijeloj državi počinje potraga za mladom majkom i istražitelji otkrivaju nasilje u braku.

programme.title: Sat vremena za ubojstvo, Michael + Thelma King
programme.desc: Kada burna skupina izađe na ulice St. Maartena, u samo sat vremena, životi američkog para zauvijek se promijene. Jesu li jednostavno bili na krivom mjestu u krivo vrijeme? Ili žrtve nečeg zlonamjerno sračunatog?

programme.title: Zločini koji su potresli Britaniju
programme.desc: Potresne zločine u novijoj povijesti Velike Britanije, koji su njene stanovnike zaprepastili i ostavili u suzama, gledamo kroz rekonstrukcije u ovoj hvaljenoj televizijskoj krim-dokumentarnoj seriji, koja se prikazuje od 2008. u Britaniji a sada i na glavnom kanalu RTL-u od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u kasnovečernjem terminu. Svjedočenja osoba koje su se zatekle na mjestima zločina, policijski intervjui i izjave obitelji žrtava - serija istražuje najstravičnije i najgnjusnije zločine Britanije i predstavlja poremećene ubojice. Prva sezona donosi šest epizoda i šest zločina - u proljeće 1999. London su uzdrmala tri bombaška napada, u kojima su se koristile bombe punjene čavlima koje su smrtno ranile tri osobe i ozlijedile još 140. Dalje, istražuje se ubojstvo Jill Dando, novinarke i TV voditeljice nađene na stubištu svoje kuće na West Endu u travnju 1999. Vodimo vas na mjesto tragičnog Dunblane masakra, u kojem je 16-ero učenika i njihov učitelj stradalo od ruku Thomasa Hamiltona. Ulazimo u farmersku kuću u Essexu, Nevilla i June Bambera, u kojoj su iz vatrenog oružja ubijeni zajedno s posvojenom kćeri Sheilaom te šetogodišnjim blizancima. Ubojstvo Rhys Jonesa, 11-godišnjeg dječaka, kojeg je usmrtio zalutali metak u blizinu njegovog doma, te ubojstvo Stephena Camerona, 21-godišnjeg mladića, koji je izboden na smrt na M25 autocesti pred svojom 17-godišnjom djevojkom, zatvaraju ovaj crni niz šokantnih zločina koji su potresli Britaniju i čiju rekonstrukciju gledamo u prvoj sezoni.

programme.desc: Show u kojem uz dobru zabavu, razgovor i seksi spotove ugošćujemo zanimljive goste i razgovaramo o tabu temama.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks _ without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better. Shark advocates Dr. Erich Ritter and Chuck Anderson have grave reservations about how far we are willing to go for a thrill. And they have intimate knowledge of the subject. Both men were brutally attacked by bull sharks. Shark Divers also examines the controversy surrounding a handful of high-profile attacks in 2008, including the first shark tourist killed while on a shark excursion.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester's team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.desc: The R.I.P. team visits the former home of the last woman hanged for witchcraft in Virginia and encounters the spirit of the still fiercely protective foreman of her farm.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Major Graham's Mansion, in the Virginia countryside, houses dark secrets that the team attempts to uncover.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your kicks on Route 66 in Flagstaff, AZ. Duck and cover! We're headed to the famous Barringer meteor crater outside of town. Then we scan the stars for heavenly bodies at Lowell Observatory. We'll learn the history of the region at the Northern Arizona History Museum, and finally swing from their many ponderosa pines at Flagstaff Extreme adventure park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We're headed upstate to Albany and Saratoga Springs. We'll take the Albany capital tour and see five former NY governors who would become US Presidents. Then, we'll board the USS Slater and see how America defended its fleet against German U-boats in WWII. We'll sample the mineral water in Saratoga Springs, and bet the farm at their famous thoroughbred raceway. Then, we'll learn how important the Battle of Saratoga was for America's future at Saratoga battlefield.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Several of the world's best kayakers are led by South African legend, Steve Fisher, on a trip down one of the most difficult rivers in the world.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: The best all-round snowboarder and skier in the world, explore and assault the southern alps of New Zealand looking for big air and beautiful light to kick off another winter season.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Alexander Graham Bell, inspired by a misunderstood German paper, aimed to send multiple tones through a wire—leading to the invention of the telephone. He discovered that voice vibrations vary electric current strength, enabling sound transmission. Though revolutionary, it took time for people to grasp its impact. Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell's principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Music Voyager

As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore fire—a force both friend and foe. Mastered by humans hundreds of thousands of years ago, fire remains as inevitable as wind or rain, yet deadly when uncontrolled. Disasters can strike anywhere: from a Brussels department store to a Rhode Island nightclub where pyrotechnics killed 100 people. Firefighters still charge into danger, hauling hoses, scaling stairs with heavy tools, and lifting 35-foot ladders to save lives.

programme.title: RV Explorers

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The haunted Graffitti House dates from the Civil War and many of its previous residents still linger.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The mighty grizzly bear. The tiny powerful ant. The lunging inimitable crocodile. The indestructible rhino beetle. The hammering mantis shrimp. Which is the strongest of them all? Grizzly Bear _ North America's sub-alpine lands are ruled by its mightiest resident. Ants _ With 12,000+ species, ants are fierce, territorial defenders, dispatching intruders with ease. Crocodile _ Ancient rulers of rivers, crocodiles have the strongest bite force ever recorded. Rhino Beetle _ This forest dweller can lift 850 times its own weight. Mantis Shrimp _ With bizarre eyes and a punch as strong as a .22 bullet, it's a tiny powerhouse.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Whale Sharks: Gentle Giants introduces us to this amazing creature through scientists who are racing against time to save the species. Utilizing space-age technology from NASA and the Hubble Telescope, researchers are able to identify, catalogue and track individual sharks. In Mexico and remote Western Australia, whale shark tourism has proven to be both a blessing and a curse, as more and more boats vie for fewer animals. The program also features the remarkable story of shark cowboys who captured and transported 4 live whale sharks (in customized jumbo jets) to the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predator vs. prey: this episode explores three bird escape tactics—climbing flight, horizontal speed, and diving. These behaviors reflect the evolutionary arms race. Birds of prey captivate us, from the mighty eagle soaring over open spaces to the peregrine falcon, the fastest animal alive. Vultures, often seen as omens, strip carcasses clean to survive. Whether elegant hunters or grim scavengers, each raptor plays its part in the Race of Life, adapting to stay one step ahead.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra's venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Plastic, once accidental, is now essential—from machines to daily items. It began with explosive billiard balls and beetle poop, leading to Bakelite and later nylon. Nylon's popularity even sparked riots during WWII. But plastic's durability and oil-based origin raise environmental concerns. Now, bioplastics grown in microorganisms—and possibly plants—offer quirky, sustainable alternatives for the future.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn the secrets behind thermos' amazing technology! And they were the sweet candy pellets we loved as a kid, but did you know that Pez was created to help people stop smoking? And find out how a steamboat inspired Samuel Langhorne Clemens to change his name to Mark Twain!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most famous train stations _ Grand Central Terminal. We'll take you on a trip to reveal its many fascinating secrets! And if they are cleaned without water, how do clothes get spotless when they are dry cleaned?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. Paying customers will soon be launching into space; tourists and their money is thought to be a major step forward into space and beyond. Blue Origin flight tests have been a great success and may launch commercial flights as soon as year's end. Virgin Galactic is also smashing mile stones towards flight certification. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The ESA _ JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Chromatic adaptation lets humans perceive consistent colors despite changing light. Some animals change color using chromatophores—for camouflage or signaling. Pink isn't a real wavelength; our brains create it by blending light. Blue is rare in nature but appears through structural features in feathers and wings. Snow camouflage helps animals blend into winter landscapes using shades of white and gray.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Monty Hall Problem shows switching choices boosts winning odds. The Birthday Problem reveals how just 23 people can have a 50% chance of shared birthdays due to multiple pairings. Gambler's Ruin proves that in a fair game, the smaller bankroll loses over time. The Infinite Hotel Paradox explores the strange logic of infinity. The Locker Riddle uses factorization to reveal why only lockers with perfect square numbers stay open.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks _ without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better. Shark advocates Dr. Erich Ritter and Chuck Anderson have grave reservations about how far we are willing to go for a thrill. And they have intimate knowledge of the subject. Both men were brutally attacked by bull sharks. Shark Divers also examines the controversy surrounding a handful of high-profile attacks in 2008, including the first shark tourist killed while on a shark excursion.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan's actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Carrion flowers like rafflesia arnoldii are rare, large, and foul-smelling, attracting flies for pollination. Aposematism uses bright colors to warn predators of toxicity, with some species mimicking these signals. Female cuckoos mimic predator calls to sneak eggs into host nests. Pheromones are chemical signals used for mating, tracking, or alarms. Deimatic behavior startles predators with sudden displays, helping prey escape

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Saccadic eye masking helps the brain blur fast eye movements for clear vision. Plants move in response to stimuli for survival and reproduction. Language shapes how we perceive color—some cultures lack words for certain hues. Color blindness stems from faulty retinal cells and can be genetic or acquired. Perspective illusion uses geometry to create depth in art, a technique refined during the Renaissance.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Drugačija divljina
programme.desc: Na maloj farmi u norveškoj šumi Payneovi žive izoliranim životom u želji da budu divlji i slobodni. Maria, Nik i njihovo četvero djece - Ulv, Falk, Freja i Ronja - dovoljni su sami sebi. Djeca se školuju kod kuće, a svi zajedno i teže povezanoj obiteljskoj dinamici i životu u skladu s prirodom. Međutim, kada obitelj pogodi tragedija, njihov je idilični svijet narušen te su prisiljeni prokrčiti nov put u moderno društvo.

programme.title: Andaluzija Michaela Portilla
programme.desc: Pridužite se Michaelu Portillu koji istražuje Andaluziju, upoznajući lokalno stanovništvo te njihove strasti. Od Ferije u Malagi, najveće ulične zabave u Španjolskoj, pa ostataka drevnih civilizacija u Cordobi, do tragova Kolumba u Huelvi sve do nevjerojatnih pećina Gruta de las Maravillas, korak po korak s njime upoznajemo prekrasan jug Španjolske.

programme.title: Osamdesete
programme.desc: Dio izvanredne dokumentarne serije „Desetljeća, koju su producirali Tom Hanks, Gary Goetzman i Mark Herzog, „Osamdesete su fascinantan, uzbudljiv skup filmova koji prikazuju desetljeće koje je promijenilo Ameriku - i svijet. Kako desetljeća prolaze, osamdesete su bile velike. Svijetu je zastao dah kad je Hladni rat došao do vrhunca i konačno do kraja. Proživjeli smo krizu AIDS-a i vidjeli kako brokeri s Wall Streeta postaju nove rock zvijezde. Disco 70-e su završile, a glazba, film i društvene promjene najavile su pomak koji i danas odjekuje. Ova fascinantna dokumentarna mini-serija briljantno koristi arhivske snimke i intervjue kako bi istaknula ključne trenutake desetljeća, čineći gledanje uvjerljivim i zabavnim, bilo da se nostalgično vraćate u posjet ili otkrivate povijest.

programme.title: Velika putovanja željeznicom kroz Veliku Britaniju
programme.desc: Sezonu po sezonu, pridružujemo se Michaelu Portillu dok putuje željeznicom uzduž i poprijeko Velike Britanije, istražujući povijest nacije i prateći ogromne društvene, političke i kulturne promjene koje su tijekom godina željeznice donijele sa sobom. Otkrivamo kako je Britanija oblikovana rastućom mrežom povijesnih željeznica, s fascinantnim uvidima i likovima na svakoj stanici na putu. Uvijek informativan i često dirljiv, serijal Željeznička putovanja nastavlja oduševljavati i zabavljati publiku diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Vrhunski dizajn u Velikoj Britaniji
programme.desc: Serija donosi pogled na neobične domove te istražuje kuće koje se grade na različitim lokacijama u Velikoj Britaniji, a svaka epizoda pokazat će koja dizajnerska rješenja najbolje funkcioniraju i zašto. Na početku epizode voditelj Kevin McCloud upoznaje klijente koji se upuštaju u projekt; s njima obilazi nekretninu i razgovara o planovima za gradnju da bismo potom vidjeli i kompjutersku vizualizaciju cijelog projekta. Nakon toga prati napredak, pregledava materijale i vodi brigu o tome hoće li sve biti završeno na vrijeme, a kad se usele stanari, McCloud opisuje cijeli proces gradnje.

programme.title: Jennifer Lopez: Dance Again, glazbeno-dokumentarni film
programme.desc: "Jennifer Lopez: Dance Again" vodi nas iza pozornice svjetske turneje Jennifer Lopez pod nazivom "Dance Again"- u sklopu koje je gostovala u 65 gradova na pet kontinenata, proputovala stotine tisuća kilometara i doprla do milijun svojih obožavatelja. Ovaj film spoj je sjajnih glazbenih izvedbi i sirovog i iskrenog pogleda u Jenniferin osobni i profesionalni život. On pokriva razdoblje od šest mjeseci i dokumentira prvu svjetsku turneju Jennifer Lopez, na koju je povela i svoje dvoje male djece.

programme.title: Nacionalna sigurnost: Priča o Arneu Treholtu
programme.desc: Godine 1985. uhićenje karizmatičnog diplomata i bivšeg državnog tajnika Arnea Treholta šokirao je njegovu rodnu Norvešku. Osuđen na 20 godina zatvora zbog špijunaže za Sovjetski Savez i Irak, Treholt i dalje poriče sve optužbe do današnjeg dana. Proveo je devet godina u strogo čuvanom zatvoru, do puštanja na slobodu početkom 90-ih, nakon što ga je pomilovala norveška vlada. S ekskluzivnim pristupom Treholtu, onima koji su bliski skandalu i stručnjacima za međunarodnu špijunažu, ovaj šestodijelni dokumentarac snimljen u New Yorku, Norveškoj i Rusiji priča fascinantnu priču o tome kako je uglednu javnu osobu s glamuroznom suprugom zavela ruska obavještajna služba.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Matangi/Maya/M. I. A.
programme.desc: Počela je kao Matangi. Kći utemeljitelja oružanog tamilskog otpora Šri Lanke, sakrila se od vlade zbog burnog i krvavog građanskog rata. Kad je njezina obitelj pobjegla u Veliku Britaniju, postala je Maya, kreativna tinejdžerka imigranata u Londonu. Napokon, svijet ju je upoznao kao M.I.A. kad je izašla na globalnu scenu, stvorivši mashup, cut-and-paste identitet koji se povlačio iz svakog kuta njenog puta; sonična knjiga skica koja je spojila tamilsku politiku, umjetničku školu punk, hip-hop ritmove i nepokolebljiv, ultra samouvjeren glas rastuće multikulturalne mladeži. MATANGI / MAYA / M.I.A. pruža neusporediv, intiman pristup umjetnici u njezinim borbama s glazbenom industrijom i glavnim medijima, kako njezin uspjeh i slava eksplodiraju, postajući jedan od najprepoznatljivijih, najprisutnijih i provokativnijih glasova u glazbi danas.

programme.title: Matangi/Maya/M. I. A.
programme.desc: Počela je kao Matangi. Kći utemeljitelja oružanog tamilskog otpora Šri Lanke, sakrila se od vlade zbog burnog i krvavog građanskog rata. programme.title: Djeca u fokusu
programme.desc: „Djeca u fokusu prikazuje petero djece, članove ansambla berlinskog Friedrichstadt-Palasta, tijekom priprema za novu dječju predstavu i to od odabira glumaca preko proba pa do velike premijere pred dvije tisuće gledatelja. Iskusiti ćemo s njima godinu dana punu izazova - duge probe s puno malih i velikih uspjeha, iščekivanje odabira glumaca za glavne uloge, kompetitivnost, prijateljstvo i na kraju velika premijera. Pored svakodnevnih priprema ući ćemo i u živote petero djece, u školi i u njihovim domovima. Pratiti ćemo njihove nade i strahove, sukobe s roditeljima i normalno ludilo puberteta. Usprkos njihovim različitim životnim pričama svi oni dijele strast za pozornicom.

programme.title: Stvar
programme.desc: Događaji koji su doveli do pada Berlinskog zida i hladnog rata ubrzali su promjene u Komunističkoj partiji Italije koja je 1989. godine objavila povjesnu promjenu. Ovaj dokumentarac bavi se budućnošću Komunističke partije Italije i budućnošću socijalističke utopije, ako je uopće tada i postojala. Opisujući ovaj film, redatelj Nanni Moretti je rekao kako je „Stvar izraz koji su ljudi koristili kao nešto što bi zamijenilo staru komunističku partiju. Moretti se u ovom filmu bavi poviješću talijanske ljevice, njezinih temeljnih principa, a iskazuje i nostalgiju za političkim stilom koji je u Italiji nestao.

programme.title: Moja imaginarna zemlja
programme.desc: Prikaz prosvjeda koji su eruptirali na ulicama čileanskog glavnog grada Santiaga 2019. u trenutku kad stanovništvo zahtijeva višu razinu demokracije i socijalne jednakosti oko obrazovanja, zdravstvene zaštite i mogućnosti zapošljavanja.

Kad je njezina obitelj pobjegla u Veliku Britaniju, postala je Maya, kreativna tinejdžerka imigranata u Londonu. Napokon, svijet ju je upoznao kao M.I.A. kad je izašla na globalnu scenu, stvorivši mashup, cut-and-paste identitet koji se povlačio iz svakog kuta njenog puta; sonična knjiga skica koja je spojila tamilsku politiku, umjetničku školu punk, hip-hop ritmove i nepokolebljiv, ultra samouvjeren glas rastuće multikulturalne mladeži. MATANGI / MAYA / M.I.A. pruža neusporediv, intiman pristup umjetnici u njezinim borbama s glazbenom industrijom i glavnim medijima, kako njezin uspjeh i slava eksplodiraju, postajući jedan od najprepoznatljivijih, najprisutnijih i provokativnijih glasova u glazbi danas.

programme.title: Nacionalna sigurnost: Priča o Arneu Treholtu
programme.desc: Godine 1985. uhićenje karizmatičnog diplomata i bivšeg državnog tajnika Arnea Treholta šokirao je njegovu rodnu Norvešku. Osuđen na 20 godina zatvora zbog špijunaže za Sovjetski Savez i Irak, Treholt i dalje poriče sve optužbe do današnjeg dana. Proveo je devet godina u strogo čuvanom zatvoru, do puštanja na slobodu početkom 90-ih, nakon što ga je pomilovala norveška vlada. S ekskluzivnim pristupom Treholtu, onima koji su bliski skandalu i stručnjacima za međunarodnu špijunažu, ovaj šestodijelni dokumentarac snimljen u New Yorku, Norveškoj i Rusiji priča fascinantnu priču o tome kako je uglednu javnu osobu s glamuroznom suprugom zavela ruska obavještajna služba.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Djeca u fokusu
programme.desc: „Djeca u fokusu prikazuje petero djece, članove ansambla berlinskog Friedrichstadt-Palasta, tijekom priprema za novu dječju predstavu i to od odabira glumaca preko proba pa do velike premijere pred dvije tisuće gledatelja. Iskusiti ćemo s njima godinu dana punu izazova - duge probe s puno malih i velikih uspjeha, iščekivanje odabira glumaca za glavne uloge, kompetitivnost, prijateljstvo i na kraju velika premijera. Pored svakodnevnih priprema ući ćemo i u živote petero djece, u školi i u njihovim domovima. Pratiti ćemo njihove nade i strahove, sukobe s roditeljima i normalno ludilo puberteta. Usprkos njihovim različitim životnim pričama svi oni dijele strast za pozornicom.

programme.title: Andaluzija Michaela Portilla
programme.desc: Pridužite se Michaelu Portillu koji istražuje Andaluziju, upoznajući lokalno stanovništvo te njihove strasti. Od Ferije u Malagi, najveće ulične zabave u Španjolskoj, pa ostataka drevnih civilizacija u Cordobi, do tragova Kolumba u Huelvi sve do nevjerojatnih pećina Gruta de las Maravillas, korak po korak s njime upoznajemo prekrasan jug Španjolske.

programme.title: Osamdesete
programme.desc: Dio izvanredne dokumentarne serije „Desetljeća, koju su producirali Tom Hanks, Gary Goetzman i Mark Herzog, „Osamdesete su fascinantan, uzbudljiv skup filmova koji prikazuju desetljeće koje je promijenilo Ameriku - i svijet. Kako desetljeća prolaze, osamdesete su bile velike. Svijetu je zastao dah kad je Hladni rat došao do vrhunca i konačno do kraja. Proživjeli smo krizu AIDS-a i vidjeli kako brokeri s Wall Streeta postaju nove rock zvijezde. Disco 70-e su završile, a glazba, film i društvene promjene najavile su pomak koji i danas odjekuje. Ova fascinantna dokumentarna mini-serija briljantno koristi arhivske snimke i intervjue kako bi istaknula ključne trenutake desetljeća, čineći gledanje uvjerljivim i zabavnim, bilo da se nostalgično vraćate u posjet ili otkrivate povijest.

programme.title: Velika putovanja željeznicom kroz Veliku Britaniju
programme.desc: Sezonu po sezonu, pridružujemo se Michaelu Portillu dok putuje željeznicom uzduž i poprijeko Velike Britanije, istražujući povijest nacije i prateći ogromne društvene, političke i kulturne promjene koje su tijekom godina željeznice donijele sa sobom. Otkrivamo kako je Britanija oblikovana rastućom mrežom povijesnih željeznica, s fascinantnim uvidima i likovima na svakoj stanici na putu. Uvijek informativan i često dirljiv, serijal Željeznička putovanja nastavlja oduševljavati i zabavljati publiku diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Stvar
programme.desc: Događaji koji su doveli do pada Berlinskog zida i hladnog rata ubrzali su promjene u Komunističkoj partiji Italije koja je 1989. godine objavila povjesnu promjenu. Ovaj dokumentarac bavi se budućnošću Komunističke partije Italije i budućnošću socijalističke utopije, ako je uopće tada i postojala. Opisujući ovaj film, redatelj Nanni Moretti je rekao kako je „Stvar izraz koji su ljudi koristili kao nešto što bi zamijenilo staru komunističku partiju. Moretti se u ovom filmu bavi poviješću talijanske ljevice, njezinih temeljnih principa, a iskazuje i nostalgiju za političkim stilom koji je u Italiji nestao.

programme.title: Moja imaginarna zemlja
programme.desc: Prikaz prosvjeda koji su eruptirali na ulicama čileanskog glavnog grada Santiaga 2019. u trenutku kad stanovništvo zahtijeva višu razinu demokracije i socijalne jednakosti oko obrazovanja, zdravstvene zaštite i mogućnosti zapošljavanja.

programme.title: Razgovor o drveću
programme.desc: Četiri starija umirovljena filmaša iz Sudana - Ibrahim Shadad, Manar Al Hilo, Suleiman Mohamed Ibrahim i Altayeb Mahdi - prepuni strasti za filmom žele ponovo otvoriti kino u gradu Omdurmanu. Taj pokušaj neće proći bez otpora uslijed desetljeća islamske cenzure i birokracije.

programme.title: U nemirnim snovima: Glazba Paula Simona, glazbeno-dokumentarni film
programme.desc: Dana 15. siječnja 2019. Paul Simon je usnio san u kojem mu je glas rekao: "Radiš na djelu Sedam psalama." U mjesecima koji su uslijedili stihovi i fraze javljali su mu se u neobičnim trenucima, katkad čak i dok je spavao. Počeo je čuti melodiju koja bi povezivala te fragmente. Proces se nastavio tijekom pandemije. Dok su se stihovi oblikovali - poput fotografija koje izranjaju iz kemijske kupke u tamnoj komori - Paul Simon se javio redatelju Alexu Gibneyu da vidi ima li interesa za to da snimi njegov proces pretvaranja osnovnih elemenata u album koji će postati Seven Psalms. Dok se mala ekipa okupljala, Gibney i producentica Svetlana Zill otputovali su u Simonov novi studio u Wimberlyju, u Teksasu, gdje je Simon uz pomoć gitare i neobrađenih vokala skicirao niz pjesama koje su istraživale vjeru, smrt, postojanje Boga (i misterij stvaranja). "Cijelo ovo djelo zapravo je rasprava koju vodim sam sa sobom o vjerovanju ili nevjerovanju", kaže Simon u filmu. Dok su se teme nove glazbe bistrile, tako se i Gibneyju javila ideja da bi te sesije mogle pružiti savršen okvir za pripovijedanje priče o Simonovoj evoluciji od dječaka iz radničke klase u Queensu do jednog od najinovativnijih i najpriznatijih kantautora u povijesti glazbe. Film suprotstavlja proces stvaranja novog albuma s arhivskim materijalima koji prate Simonovu karijeru i njegov kreativni put, uključujući dosad neviđeni materijal nastao u povijesnim trenucima poput snimanja pjesama Bridge Over Troubled Water i Graceland te nezaboravnog koncerta Simona i Garfunkela u Central Parku, a 10 godina poslije i Simonovog solo koncerta pred 750.000 ljudi na istom mjestu. Film je susret dvojice majstora zanata, dubok uvid u čudo i čaroliju stvaranja pjesama te istraživanje života iznimne kreativnosti koji nije izgubio ništa od svoje znatiželje, ambicije i misterija.

programme.title: Talijanska kuhinja osvaja Ameriku
programme.desc: Gastronomska kultura rezultat je putovanja ljudi u potrazi za novim jelima. Najbolji dokaz za to je talijanska hrana koja je za vrijeme velkikih migracija putovala u Ameriku. Gotovo stotinu godina kasnije, ovaj dokumentarac prati korake hrane i njezino putovanje u New York i Buenos Aires i pronalazi osnove nove tradicije, talijanske hrane u emigraciji. Kakva je povezanost hrane u New Yorku s Italijom?Možemo li govoriti o talijanskoj hrani izvan Italije? Kroz iskaze brojnih ljudi diljem svijeta otkrivamo kako se talijanska hrana adaptirala diljem svijeta.
